KaTeX 0.19.0
https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/tag/v0.19.0
https://katex.org/

Files from the published npm package katex@0.19.0 (dist/): the ESM build
katex.mjs, the mhchem extension contrib/mhchem.mjs (chemistry with \ce and \pu),
katex.min.css and the woff2 fonts. The stylesheet also names woff and ttf
fonts, which are not shipped: every browser Chat supports uses the woff2 files
listed first. The only change is removing sourceMappingURL comments.
No CDN requests or npm install are required by Obleth Chat at build/runtime.

Upstream tarball:
https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.0.tgz
SHA-512 integrity:
sha512-v6Tznz3zJ7u3niRCoDTsumM2+HA2XXcCu+WAacCeHD2z3p9A9Ks987o5FzfTGBN0e8A0vjEgIDvLbICrXpdw/Q==

KaTeX is MIT licensed; see LICENSE. contrib/mhchem.mjs is adapted from the
MathJax mhchem extension (Copyright (c) 2011-2015 The MathJax Consortium,
Copyright (c) 2015-2018 Martin Hensel), Apache License 2.0, as stated in its
header. The browser build has no bundled dependencies.

Update by downloading a reviewed tagged npm release with npm pack
--ignore-scripts, verifying the registry integrity, and replacing these files
and the license. Run tests/markdown.test.mjs after updates.
